[h1]The Boxing Room[/h1]

Ladieeees and Gentleman!!! 
Welcome, to The Golden Caravan Arena! 
This is not only a casino, it's also the perfect venue for your favorite boxing matches. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172328/2ee9ce7fff6e3d83c01b0a4cce262fc402ea05fb.png[/img]

[h1]The Enemies[/h1]
That's great news for tourists, but bad news for Charlie!
He will now have to face these folks, and they're not joking around:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172328/4ba02788cbf6b9f2dca63a6f9f6d13f94351eaf8.png[/img]

[h1]Charlie[/h1]
But worry not! He is prepared to fight back, armored to the teeth with giant gloves, a tie, and more handsome than ever.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172328/0d1176613ea797872dbc52656265eccc263268e7.png[/img]

[h1]The Story[/h1]
We expanded the story, introducing a very important character: Mr. Falconetti. 
This is not your average character, and without revealing any details, let's say Charlie and him know each other for a while...

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172328/79a622a171f380288816b0841ef857750b319fd3.png[/img]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
We're now working on new mechanics, and will be ready very soon, so stay tuned.
We hope you like this update, let us know what you think, and let's get ready to ruuuumbleeee!
Remember to wishlist, and follow us in all our social media channels!
